verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev documents queues with a configurable `concurrencyLimit` per task queue, plus concurrency keys for per-user queue logic, so developers can queue executions and cap parallelism to protect downstream services. Queued runs are also visible in the dashboard. Missing for 10: explicit time-window rate limiting (e.g., N runs per second/minute) as opposed to concurrency caps, in-depth docs showing rate-limit use cases, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
